app.name: Crunchyroll
app.description: The world's largest anime streaming platform, offering a vast library of anime, manga, and Asian dramas.

verdict.one_liner: Collects extensive usage data and shares it with third parties for advertising and analytics.
verdict.summary: Crunchyroll collects detailed usage information including webpages viewed, video history, and device identifiers. It shares data with business partners, Sony group companies, and third-party platforms for advertising, analytics, and matching purposes. The policy mentions converting email or phone numbers into unique values for ad matching. While it provides some user rights and opt-outs, it retains broad rights to keep residual data and does not clearly commit to proactive notifications for policy changes.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Crunchyroll engages in significant behavioral tracking and shares personal data with multiple third parties for advertising and analytics. The extensive data collection and broad retention rights are notable privacy concerns.

red.title: Extensive behavioral tracking
red.plain_english: The policy states it collects usage information including your browser type, operating system, webpages and apps you view, video history, and what you looked at before accessing the Content. It also uses cookies, web beacons, and tracking technologies to personalize ads and analyze browsing behavior.

red.title: Shares data for targeted advertising
red.plain_english: The policy states it may share your personal data with business partners, Sony group companies, and third-party platforms for advertising and analytics. It also mentions converting your email address or telephone number into a unique value for ad matching.

red.title: Third-party cross-device tracking
red.plain_english: The policy notes that third parties may use tracking technologies for interest-based advertising, including cross-device tracking, through cookies and similar technologies.

red.title: Shares data with Sony group companies
red.plain_english: The policy states it may disclose personal data to other Sony group companies for analytics, account authentication, account management, and direct marketing purposes.

green.title: Some user rights available
green.plain_english: The policy states you may have rights to access, review, delete, or object to processing of your personal data where required by applicable law.

green.title: Opt-out for marketing communications
green.plain_english: Users can opt out of email newsletters and unsubscribe from SMS or MMS messages by replying STOP.

green.title: No automated decision-making with legal effects
green.plain_english: The policy states it does not carry out fully automated decision-making or profiling that has a legal or similarly significant effect on you.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The policy states it may use GPS, geo-filtering, and other location-aware technologies to locate you, sometimes precisely, for purposes such as verifying your location, delivering or restricting content, and advertising based on your location. Some service providers may also provide the physical location of your device.
categories.detail: The policy mentions GPS, geo-filtering, and location-aware technologies for verifying location, territory restrictions, and location-based advertising. Users can turn off precise geo-location tracking through device settings. Some service providers may also provide the physical location of the device used to access the Content.
categories.policy_excerpt: Subject to applicable laws, we may use GPS (global positioning systems) software, geo-filtering and other location-aware technologies to locate (sometimes precisely) you for purposes such as verifying your location and delivering or restricting content (e.g. territory restrictions) and advertising based on your location. You can turn off precise geo-location tracking through the location settings on your device and/or in our Content (if available). Some service providers may also provide us with the physical location of the device used to access the Content.
concerns: Precise location may be used for advertising
Location used for content territory restrictions

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: The policy states it may share your data with business partners, other Sony group companies, third-party service providers, and for business reorganization purposes. It may also share if you consent for marketing.
categories.detail: The policy describes sharing with business partners, other Sony group companies for analytics and direct marketing, third parties providing services (hosting, email, advertising, data analysis), and in business reorganizations. It states: 'We may ask for your consent to share your Personal Data with third parties for their own marketing purposes.' The policy does not contain an explicit statement that it does not sell personal data for money.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may disclose Personal Data to our business partners or other Sony group companies in accordance with applicable law... We share data with our business partners, as well as third parties who perform functions on our behalf, such as hosting or operating our site and apps, sending emails, performing marketing and advertising services, and carrying out data analysis... We may ask for your consent to share your Personal Data with third parties for their own marketing purposes... In addition, we work with third-party platforms and websites (such as social networking platforms) to serve targeted advertisements on such third-party services and platforms to you or others, and we may convert your email address, telephone number, or other information into a unique value and provide it to these third-party platforms for matching purposes.
concerns: Data shared with advertisers and social platforms
Shared with Sony affiliates for analytics and marketing
Email and phone may be converted to unique values for ad matching
Data may transfer during business reorganization

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: The policy states it collects identification data like your name, date of birth, gender, postal address, username, and password. It also collects contact information like your email and phone number, and payment information for subscriptions.
categories.detail: The policy describes 'Identification Data' (name, surname, date of birth, gender, postal address, username, password, security questions), 'Contact Information' (email, phone number), and 'Payment Information' (card details, subscription status, payment history). Social login via third-party services is mentioned under Third-Party Services.
categories.policy_excerpt: Identification Data: Information that allows us to differentiate you from other individuals. This may include demographic information, such as: name and surname, date of birth, gender, postal address, username, password, and answers to account security questions. Contact Information: Information that allows us to keep in touch with you. This may include: email address and phone number. Payment Information: information that allows us or our third party providers to process payments where required to grant you access to our Content, related purchase or subscription status, and payment history.
concerns: Financial info collected
Social login links external data

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: The policy states it uses cookies, web beacons, and tracking technologies to personalize content and advertising, remember your preferences, analyze usage, and serve targeted ads. It may convert your email or phone into a unique value for ad matching.
categories.detail: The policy describes three purposes for tracking technologies: (1) providing requested services and settings, (2) showing relevant ads and content recommendations (including cross-device tracking), and (3) analyzing and improving browsing experience. It explicitly states: 'we may convert your email address, telephone number, or other information into a unique value and provide it to these third-party platforms for matching purposes.' It uses Adobe and Google analytics. Location-aware technologies including GPS may be used for location-based advertising.
categories.policy_excerpt: Cookies, web beacons (also known as "tracking pixels") and other tracking technologies may be used by SPE and third parties including other Sony group companies to collect information about your interactions with the Content or the emails which SPE sends to you... we may convert your email address, telephone number, or other information into a unique value and provide it to these third-party platforms for matching purposes... Subject to applicable laws, we may use GPS (global positioning systems) software, geo-filtering and other location-aware technologies to locate (sometimes precisely) you for purposes such as verifying your location and delivering or restricting content (e.g. territory restrictions) and advertising based on your location.
concerns: Email and phone converted to unique values for ad matching
Cross-device tracking mentioned
GPS used for location-based advertising
Extensive activity tracking across apps and emails

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: The policy mentions that where online services are provided to children and consent is required by law, parental or guardian consent is required. It does not specify age thresholds or detailed child protection practices.
categories.detail: The policy only references children in the context of requiring parental or guardian consent when legally required because a child is below a relevant age threshold. It does not mention COPPA or specify what ages are considered children.
categories.policy_excerpt: Where we are providing online services to children and the relevant processing requires consent, to the extent required by law (for example because the child is below a relevant age threshold) we require parental or guardian consent to do this.
concerns: No specific age threshold or child protection details provided

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: The policy states it collects usage information including your browser type, operating system, webpages and apps you view, how long you view them, game or video history, and what you looked at before accessing their content. It also automatically collects your IP address.
categories.detail: Usage Information includes internet browser type and version, operating system, service provider, webpages/videos/apps viewed, time viewed, game or video history, skill level, demographic info, time zone, language, and what you looked at before accessing Content. IP address is automatically collected as a device identifier.
categories.policy_excerpt: Usage Information may consist of your internet browser type and version, operating system, service provider, the webpages, videos and apps you viewed, the time you viewed them and for how long, game or video history, skill level, demographic information about you (such as your age, gender, language, location and interest areas, where available), time zone, language, and what you looked at before accessing our Content. Device Identifiers: We may also automatically collect your IP address or other unique identifier for the computer, mobile device, technology, or other device you use to access the Content.
concerns: Browsing and viewing history collected
IP address collected automatically

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: The policy states it automatically collects your IP address and other unique identifiers for the device you use to access the Content. Some service providers may also provide the physical location of your device.
categories.detail: The policy describes collecting IP addresses and unique identifiers automatically assigned to devices. It notes that some service providers may provide physical location. It does not mention advertising IDs or cross-app tracking in the provided text.
categories.policy_excerpt: Device Identifiers: We may also automatically collect your IP address or other unique identifier for the computer, mobile device, technology, or other device you use to access the Content. A unique identifier is a number that is automatically assigned to your device when you access a web site or its servers, and our computers identify your device by this number. Some service providers may also provide us with the physical location of the device used to access the Content.
concerns: Unique device identifiers collected automatically
Service providers may provide device physical location

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: The policy states you may have rights to access, review, delete, or object to processing of your personal data where required by applicable law. However, it notes that residual or cached data may remain archived, and it reserves the right to retain data as permitted or required by law.
categories.detail: The policy describes rights to access, review, port, delete, block, object to, or withdraw consent to processing of Personal Data, subject to applicable law. It explicitly states that residual and/or cached data may remain archived, and reserves the right to retain data as permitted or required by law or for as long as reasonably necessary.
categories.policy_excerpt: Where required by applicable law, you may have the right to obtain confirmation that we maintain certain Personal Data relating to you, to verify its content, origin, and accuracy, as well as the right to access, review, port, delete, or to block or to object to, or withdraw consent to the processing of certain Personal Data... We will make reasonable efforts to make such requested changes in our then-active and relevant consumer databases as soon as practicable, but it is not always possible to change, remove or delete your information or public postings from our databases and residual and/or cached data may remain archived thereafter if our retention of this data falls within an exemption from the fulfilment of your data subject rights under applicable law. Further, we reserve the right to retain your Personal Data (a) as permitted by applicable law; (b) as required by applicable law; and (c) for so long as reasonably necessary to fulfil the purposes for which the data is retained except to the extent prohibited by applicable law.
concerns: Residual and cached data may remain after deletion request
Data may be retained as required or permitted by law

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: The policy states it may be updated from time to time, and the effective date is posted above. It says updated versions will be posted on the Content and consent will be asked when legally required by applicable law.
categories.detail: The policy states updates are posted and users are encouraged to visit periodically. Consent is asked when legally required. There is no explicit mention of proactive user notification (e.g., email) for changes.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may update this Privacy and Cookies Policy from time to time as our services and privacy practices change, or as required by law. The effective date of our Privacy and Cookies Policy is posted above, and we encourage you to visit our Content periodically to stay informed about our privacy practices. We will post the updated version of the Privacy and Cookies Policy on our Content and ask for your consent when legally required by applicable law.
concerns: No explicit proactive notification mentioned
Users must check periodically for updates
